rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Look! Here's my puddle!
rows.heard: Look, here's my puddle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Oops. I checked. It's wet.
rows.heard: Oops, I checked it's wet.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я её сторожу. Вчера у крыльца тоже была лужа. А утром — сухо!
rows.text: I'm guarding it. Yesterday there was a puddle by the porch too. And in the morning, it was dry!
rows.heard: I'm guarding it. Yesterday there was a puddle by the porch too, and in the morning it was dry.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Nothing left at all?
rows.heard: Nothing left at all.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ни капельки. Даже записки не оставила.
rows.text: Not a drop. It didn't even leave a note.
rows.heard: Not a drop, it didn't even leave a note.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I made a list of suspects.
rows.heard: I made a list of suspects.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: And who's on it?
rows.heard: And who's on it?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Голодный голубь. Слон из зоопарка. И кот Барсик.
rows.text: A hungry pigeon. An elephant from the zoo. And Barsik the cat.
rows.heard: A hungry pigeon, an elephant from the zoo, and Barsick the cat.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: I only drink from a cup!
rows.heard: I only drink from a cup.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: That's what they all say.
rows.heard: That's what they all say.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Давайте лучше проверим. Измерим лужу шагами.
rows.text: Let's check instead. We'll measure the puddle in steps.
rows.heard: Let's check instead, we'll measure the puddle in steps.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I'll measure it!
rows.heard: I'll measure it

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Раз, два, три, четыре! Четыре шага!
rows.text: One, two, three, four! Four steps!

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Let's come back in an hour and see.
rows.heard: Let's come back in an hour and see.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Здесь вчера тоже шёл дождь. А луж нет.
rows.text: It rained here yesterday too. But there are no puddles.
rows.heard: It rained here yesterday too, but there are no puddles.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Maybe someone drank them too?
rows.heard: Maybe someone drank them too.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The list of suspects is growing.
rows.heard: The list of suspects is growing.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: The ground is wet!
rows.heard: The ground is wet.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Вода ушла в землю. Земля впитывает её, как губка.
rows.text: The water went into the ground. The ground soaks it up like a sponge.
rows.heard: The water went into the ground. The ground soaks it up like a sponge.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, на лугу лужи выпила земля!
rows.text: So the ground drank the puddles in the meadow!
rows.heard: So the ground drank the puddles in the meadow.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: На лугу — да. А на улице асфальт. Он воду не пропускает.
rows.text: In the meadow, yes. But the street has asphalt. Water can't get through it.
rows.heard: In the meadow, yes, but the street his asphalt, water can't get through it.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Тогда куда девается вода из лужи на асфальте?
rows.text: Then where does the water from a puddle on asphalt go?
rows.heard: Then, where does the water from a puddle on asphalt go?

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Did the acorn get some water too?
rows.heard: Did the acorn get some water too?

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Yes, it did. The soil around it is damp.
rows.heard: Yes it did, the soil around it is damp.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: I'll write it in my diary.
rows.heard: I'll write it in my diary.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Дождь. Земля мокрая. Жёлудь получил воду
rows.text: Rain. Wet ground. The acorn got water.
rows.heard: Rain wet ground. The acorn got water.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Смотрите! Вот маленькая лужа! Она похудела!
rows.text: Look! Here's the little puddle! It got thinner!
rows.heard: Look, here's the little puddle. It got thinner.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: One, two! Only two steps!
rows.heard: One, two, only two steps.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: And this morning it was four!
rows.heard: And this morning it was four.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Maybe the puddle goes jogging in the morning.
rows.heard: Maybe the puddle goes jogging in the morning.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Вода отступила от края. Лужа стала меньше.
rows.text: The water moved back from the edge. The puddle got smaller.
rows.heard: The water moved back from the edge. The puddle got smaller.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А по краям асфальт уже сухой.
rows.text: And the asphalt around it is already dry.
rows.heard: and the asphalt around it is already dry.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я с неё глаз не сводил. Почти.
rows.text: I never took my eyes off it. Almost.
rows.heard: I never took my eyes off it, almost.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Almost?
rows.heard: Almost.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I looked at a butterfly just once.
rows.heard: I looked at a butterfly just once.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Посмотрите на небо. Солнце светит прямо на лужу.
rows.text: Look at the sky. The sun shines right on the puddle.
rows.heard: Look at the sky, the sun shines right on the puddle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Is the sun drinking the puddle with a straw?
rows.heard: Is the sun drinking the puddle with a straw?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Almost right, Ron.
rows.heard: Almost right Ron.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Солнце не пьёт. Оно греет воду.
rows.text: The sun doesn't drink. It warms the water.
rows.heard: The sun doesn't drink, it warms the water.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Тёплая вода понемногу превращается в пар. Пар улетает в воздух.
rows.text: Warm water slowly turns into vapor. The vapor flies up into the air.
rows.heard: Warm water slowly turns into vapor. The vapor flies up into the air.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А почему мы его не видим?
rows.text: Why can't we see it?
rows.heard: Why can't we see it?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Этот пар невидимый. Вода улетает крошечными частичками — их не разглядеть.
rows.text: This vapor is invisible. Water flies away in tiny bits, too small to see.
rows.heard: This paper is invisible. Water flies away in tiny bits, too small to see.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Invisible water? That's sneaky!
rows.heard: Invisible water, that's sneaky.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я помогу ей улететь. Я буду ветром!
rows.text: Then I'll help it fly away. I'll be the wind!
rows.heard: Then I'll help it fly away. I'll be the wind.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Рон, так ты сам высохнешь быстрее лужи!
rows.text: Ron, you'll dry out faster than the puddle!
rows.heard: Run! You'll dry out faster than the puddle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I didn't even get wet.
rows.heard: I didn't even get wet.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Can we see vapor for real?
rows.heard: Can we see vapor for real?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Yes. Let's go home, I'll show you.
rows.heard: Yes, let's go home, I'll show you.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.text: At home, Barsik put the kettle on.
rows.heard: At home, Barsik put the kettle on.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.text: Barsik poured the tea.
rows.heard: Barsak poured the tea.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите над чашкой. Белое облачко — это пар.
rows.text: Look above the cup. That little white cloud is steam.
rows.heard: Look above the cup. That little white cloud is steam.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: It's going up!
rows.heard: It's going up.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Горячая вода превращается в пар быстро. А на солнце — медленно.
rows.text: Hot water turns into steam fast. In the sun, it's slow.
rows.heard: Hot water turns into steam fast. In the sun, it's slow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Сейчас я его поймаю! Подержу холодную ложку над чашкой.
rows.text: I'll catch it! I'll hold a cold spoon over the cup.
rows.heard: I'll catch it, I'll hold a cold spoon over the cup.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Oh! There are drops on the spoon!
rows.heard: Oh, there are drops on the spoon.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Пар коснулся холодной ложки и снова стал водой.
rows.text: The steam touched the cold spoon and turned back into water.
rows.heard: The steam touched the cold spoon and turned back into water.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Значит, вода может улететь — и вернуться?
rows.text: So water can fly away and come back?
rows.heard: So water can fly away and come back.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Может. Запомните это. Нам ещё пригодится.
rows.text: It can. Remember that. We'll need it later.
rows.heard: It can, remember that. We'll need it later.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Поймал пар. Но он сразу намок.
rows.text: I caught the steam. But it got wet right away.
rows.heard: I caught the steam, but it got wet right away.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Давайте проверим, где вода улетает быстрее.
rows.text: Let's check where water flies away faster.
rows.heard: Let's check where water flies away faster.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Let's pour a little water into a plate.
rows.heard: Let's pour a little water into a plate.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: And the same into a cup.
rows.heard: and the same into a cup.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: The plate is wide. And the cup is narrow.
rows.heard: The plate is wide, and the cup is narrow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Спорим, тарелка проиграет? Она же плоская!
rows.text: I bet the plate will lose. It's so flat!
rows.heard: I bet the plate will lose. It's so flat.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Поставим обе на солнечное окно и посмотрим завтра.
rows.text: Let's put both on the sunny window and look tomorrow.
rows.heard: Let's put both on the sunny window and look tomorrow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I'll stand guard.
rows.heard: I'll stand guard.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Again?
rows.heard: Again.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I'm an expert puddle guard now.
rows.heard: I'm an expert puddle guard now.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The puddle dried up!
rows.heard: The puddle dried up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Zero steps! Nothing to measure.
rows.heard: Zero steps, nothing to measure.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Подозреваемых отпускаем. Голубь, слон и Барсик свободны!
rows.text: The suspects are free to go. The pigeon, the elephant and Barsik!
rows.heard: The suspects are free to go. The pigeon, the elephant and barsick.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Thank you, Mister Detective.
rows.heard: Thank you, Mr. Detective.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Днём было солнце. И ещё дул ветер.
rows.text: It was sunny today. And the wind was blowing.
rows.heard: It was sunny today and the wind was blowing.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Why does the wind matter?
rows.heard: Why does the wind matter?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Ветер уносит пар от лужи. Тогда вода улетает ещё быстрее.
rows.text: The wind carries the vapor away from the puddle. Then water flies away even faster.
rows.heard: When it carries the vapor away from the puddle, then water flies away even faster.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Как когда сушат бельё на ветру?
rows.text: Like when laundry dries in the wind?
rows.heard: like when laundry dries in the wind.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Бельё сохнет так же, как лужа.
rows.text: Yes. Laundry dries just like a puddle.
rows.heard: Yes, laundry dries just like a puddle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Теперь я понял, куда делась вчерашняя лужа.
rows.text: Now I know where yesterday's puddle went.
rows.heard: Now I know where yesterday's puddle went.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Where?
rows.heard: Where?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: It flew up into the sky. Without asking!
rows.heard: It flew up into the sky without asking.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Давайте поиграем! Я спрашиваю, а вы отвечаете.
rows.text: Let's play! I ask, and you answer.
rows.heard: Let's play, I ask and you answer.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Go ahead!
rows.heard: Go ahead.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Где лужа высохнет быстрее: на солнце или в тени?
rows.text: Where does a puddle dry faster: in the sun or in the shade?
rows.heard: Where does a puddle dry faster in the sun or in the shade?

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: In the sun! The sun warms the water.
rows.heard: In the sun, the sun warms the water.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Правильно! А где быстрее: в тихий день или на ветру?
rows.text: Right! And where is it faster: on a calm day or in the wind?
rows.heard: Right and where is it faster? On a calm day or in the wind?

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: In the wind. The wind carries the vapor away.
rows.heard: In the wind, the wind carries the vapor away.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А лужа на лугу куда девается?
rows.text: And where does a puddle in the meadow go?
rows.heard: And where does the puddle in the meadow go?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The ground drinks it!
rows.heard: The ground drinks it.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: The water soaks into the ground.
rows.heard: The water soaks into the ground.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я так и сказал. Только вкуснее.
rows.text: That's what I said. Just tastier.
rows.heard: That's what I said, just tastier.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Everyone answered!
rows.heard: Everyone answered.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Filya, you're great at running the game.
rows.heard: Philia, you're great at running the game.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Утром друзья проверили тарелку и чашку.
rows.text: In the morning, the friends checked the plate and the cup.
rows.heard: In the morning, the friends check the plate and the cup.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: The plate is dry!
rows.heard: The plate is dry.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А в чашке вода ещё осталась.
rows.text: But there's still water in the cup.
rows.heard: but there's still water in the cup.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The flat plate won!
rows.heard: The flat plate won.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: У тарелки вода широкая. Её большая часть касается воздуха.
rows.text: In the plate, the water is wide. Most of it touches the air.
rows.heard: In the plate, the water is wide. Most of it touches the air.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Поэтому вода из тарелки улетела быстрее.
rows.text: That's why the water in the plate flew away faster.
rows.heard: That's why the water in the plate flew away faster.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Значит, широкая мелкая лужа сохнет быстро.
rows.text: So a wide, shallow puddle dries fast.
rows.heard: So a wide, shallow puddle dries fast.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: And a deep one dries slowly.
rows.heard: and the deep one dries slowly.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I'll remember. Deep puddles are the most patient.
rows.heard: I'll remember, deep puddles are the most patient.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Look what I found! A compass!
rows.heard: Look what I found, a compass.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: What can it do?
rows.heard: What can it do?

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: The arrow points over there.
rows.heard: The arrow points over there.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And now?
rows.heard: And now...

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Still there!
rows.heard: is still there.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And now?
rows.heard: And now...

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: There again!
rows.heard: There again.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: What a stubborn arrow!
rows.heard: What a stubborn arrow.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Помните загадку? Что помогает найти дорогу, хотя само никуда не идёт?
rows.text: Remember the riddle? What helps you find the way, but never goes anywhere itself?
rows.heard: Remember the riddle. What helps you find the way, but never goes anywhere itself.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: It's a compass!
rows.heard: It's a compass.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Завтра узнаем, почему стрелка всегда смотрит в одну сторону.
rows.text: Tomorrow we'll find out why the arrow always points the same way.
rows.heard: Tomorrow we'll find out why the arrow always points the same way.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Может, ей там просто что-то очень нравится?
rows.text: Maybe it just really likes something over there?
rows.heard: Maybe it just really likes something over there.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode.
